It admits 123 SET-02 growth ceilings, two literal-title child removals, 24 finite signed native-credit carriers, and nine B6-payload-preserving static-prefix effect representations; it does not derive an expected row from current player output.
It does not establish gameplay, save, Library, performance, native, or release acceptance. Unresolved classes remain comparison blockers.
